title: Mixed Event — Happy New Year! Lion Dance Robot's New Year's Show! — Episode3 The Sea & Meteor Shower

meta.Event: Happy New Year! Lion Dance Robot's New Year's Show!
meta.Event Outline: After successfully wrapping up their ambassadorial performances, Wonderlands×Showtime is preparing to put on a New Year's show at the new and improved Wonder Stage. Unfortunately, Lion Dance Robot seems to be feeling a bit under the weather...

rows.Line: New Year's Day - Just before sunrise
Beach

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Happy New Year!!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh... Isn't it great to be able to face the sea and say that to bring in the new year?! It's like we're experiencing the peak of our youth!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Yeah, totally!
This is gonna be so memorable☆>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... But it's so cold...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Winter by the sea usually is...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <We can't really tell how cold it is. I hope you girls have a way to stay warm...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We do. We made sure to bring hand warmers and hot tea, so we should be able to stay warm until the sun rises.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Also, I was really surprised to hear that you were all going to the beach on New Year's Day.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <You suggested it, right, Saki?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup!
I watched this show where a group of friends went to the beach to see the first sunrise, and I thought it was such a beautiful scene!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Geez, you always get influenced by those kinds of things...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <At the same time, you only get one chance per year to do something like this, right?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I'm sure it'll be a nice experience...>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
If only SEKAI had seas and oceans.
Then we'd be able to do this together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We're more than happy that we get to be with you like this. We can even hear the waves just fine.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Eep... The wind's so cold...!
Let's see how much time is left until the sun's supposed to rise...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Looks like we'll still be waiting for a bit...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I feel like you girls got there really early.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...!
We left the convenience store because we saw all these people gathering. We thought that meant we'd be in for an amazing sunrise, but...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <They all have fancy cameras set up, so I have to think that they came here early to claim a good spot.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I think you're right.
Since we have some time, why don't we head back to the convenience store for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sounds good.
Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, it's just... I thought I heard a familiar voice...

Oh, excellent!
The sun looks like it's going to come up at any moment!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
...!
Th-That voice...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Wait a second... That's Saki!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which means... You must be here with Ichika and company!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ts-Tsukasa...?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
What's he doing here...?!
Uh oh... Miku, you and the others need to hide.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Okay, hiding!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hm? Hoshino...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, Kusanagi, you're here too...!
Hang on. Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh?! Hi, everyone!
Happy Newonderhoy Year!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! What a happy coincidence! And a wonderful way to start the new year!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Is it really a happy coincidence, though...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho, shh!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll be performing in a show here later. It'd be nice if you all stopped by to watch.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
A show?
H-Here?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! We wanted to do some shows in a bunch of different places during New Year's, and my big sis is driving us around♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I see...
But a show by the beach isn't something you see every day.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um so... Since it's going to be cold until the sun rises, we received permission to put on a performance while everybody waits.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, okay.
The adults might be okay with waiting quietly, but the kids do seem pretty bored.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. It'd be great if you guys all joined in☆

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Us?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes!
For this show to work, we'll need some members of the audience to volunteer...

rows.Speaker: Hinata's Voice
rows.Line: Everyone! It's almost time!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, already?
We'll see you all again very soon!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, Tsukasa! Wait!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It's almost time...
But where are they going to perform...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Hah hah hah hah!”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, look over there! It's Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line: “After ten years of toil, I, Tsukasanosuke Tenma, have at long last discovered the greatest treasure under the sun!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line: “Heh heh heh. So, let us see what is inside!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, Robo-Nene! Flash your lights!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Engaging.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Whoa...! I-It's so bright...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's as if the sun just rose!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line:
“Ah, such a heavenly light...!
This must be a treasure of immeasurable wealth!”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I-Is that a dancing lion...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line:
“Waaaaaaaaah!!!
Wh-What is this?!”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Haha...!
So much chaos! It definitely feels like one of their shows!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah...
And it goes with the time of year.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm looking forward to seeing what kind of story they'll be presenting us!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line: “Ah, we have arrived at our first village! Now we must find a way to put smiles on the faces of its residents...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line: “I know! A dance should do nicely!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line: “However, some may not be particularly enthralled by that... If only we had some music to... Of course!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line:
“Can any of you here sing?!
We wish to perform a dance while you do!”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, is this what they were talking about before? The part where they'll need volunteers from the audience...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line:
“You there, young lady!
How would you like to sing for us?!”

rows.Speaker: Little Girl
rows.Line:
Sing? Sure!
♪~~~~

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line:
“Ah, how sublime!
We shall dance while you sing!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line: “Yes! A wonderful dance to go with a wonderful singing performance! Everyone, let us give this young lady a round of applause!”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So this is how they wanted to interact with the audience. It's incredible how they're able to improvise a dance based on how their volunteer sings...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line: “Now, are there any others out there who would like to sing for us?! Aha...!”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I-Ichi, I think he's looking at you...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line: “The young lady with the long hair. You seem like someone who can sing! What say you?!”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wh-What...?! Me?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Neat...
Break a leg, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho, just because he didn't pick you to sing...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line:
“Will you not sing a song for us?
Any song will do!”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Th-That's easier said than done...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You can do it, Ichi! We believe in you! And if you don't feel great about doing this alone, I'll sing with you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Quiver*

rows.Speaker: First Sunrise Viewers
rows.Line: Is she gonna sing next?

rows.Speaker: First Sunrise Viewers
rows.Line: You can do it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I-I'm really embarrassed about doing this... But my goal's to go pro, so this shouldn't be a problem for me...!

rows.Speaker: First Sunrise Viewers
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
She's really good!

rows.Speaker: First Sunrise Viewers
rows.Line:
Yeah!
What if she goes pro someday?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Ah, so she chose this sort of song...! It's very like her to, and she's singing with so much power!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (So, we'll need to do our best to match that!)

rows.Speaker: First Sunrise Viewers
rows.Line: Hey, what's going on down by the beach?

rows.Speaker: First Sunrise Viewers
rows.Line:
I think it's a New Year's event.
Wanna go check it out?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, look...!
More and more people are starting to gather!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Ichi and Tsukasa look like they're having fun! We should sing along!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: C'mon, Shiho, Hona! Don't be shy!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Fine...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line:
“Ah, such wonderful singing voices!
And what a festive atmosphere!”

rows.Speaker: Lion-Dog
rows.Line:
“Woof woof!
You guys sounded like you were having a lot of fun singing together!”

rows.Speaker: Lion-Dog
rows.Line: “Mr. Traveling Performer, can I join you on your journey!?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line: “Hm? Ah, a Lion-Dog. You are quite a rare sight. Why not? The more the merrier I say.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line: “So, let us travel together!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line: “And let us spread smiles to all the people of this village!”

rows.Speaker: Lion-Dog
rows.Line: “Yeah!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you all very much!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ichika, Saki, Honami, Shiho!
Thank you all for participating! We were able to put on a wonderful show because of all of you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
We're glad that we could help.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Indeed you did!
I wish you the best of luck as you all try to move people's hearts with your music!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, we need to get to our next stop! Until next time!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay, have fun!
And let's have some New Year's food together later tonight!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
They came and went like a storm...
But it ended up being pretty fun.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yes, it did.
I'd completely forgotten about how cold it was.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Same!
And the sun should be coming up at any moment... So we might as well wait here♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I popped out to see what was going on when I heard the four of them singing...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Hehe.
But they all have these beautiful smiles on their faces now.>
